sentences.en: A power failure contributed to the confusion in the hall.
sentences.zh: 停电导致大厅里一片混乱。

sentences.en: I took advantage of the confusion and attacked the enemy.
sentences.zh: 我趁混乱之机攻击了敌人。

sentences.en: That is a policy of weakness, helplessness, and complete confusion.
sentences.zh: 那是一种软弱、无助且完全不知所措的政策。

senses.zh: 困惑, 糊涂 - 混淆, 混同 - 混乱, 骚乱
